rationale: Pm=0.9, prefault_pmax=2.0, postfault_pmax=1.5, H=4.0 s, f0=50 Hz. delta0=asin(0.9/2.0)=26.7437 deg. delta_max=180-asin(0.9/1.5)=143.1301 deg. cos(delta_cr)=(Pm*(delta_max-delta0)+postfault_pmax*cos(delta_max))/postfault_pmax gives delta_cr=65.2414 deg. t_cr=sqrt(4*H*(delta_cr-delta0)/(2*pi*f0*Pm))=0.19499 s.
